name: Nystrom & Associates
one_liner: A Midwest outpatient practice (now Sagent Behavioral Health) offering therapy and psychiatry at clinics in Minnesota and nearby states or by video.

short_description: A Minnesota-based therapy and psychiatry group practice, renamed Sagent Behavioral Health in 2025, with 80+ clinics in five states plus telehealth.
long_description: Nystrom & Associates is a Minnesota outpatient mental health group practice. In October 2025 it and its affiliated brands (including Ellie Mental Health in Minnesota, LifeWorks and Psychiatric Associates in Iowa, Sandhill Counseling in Missouri and Vantage Point in Wisconsin) began operating under one name, Sagent Behavioral Health; the legal entity is still Nystrom & Associates, Ltd. It reports more than 80 clinic locations across Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri, North Dakota and Wisconsin, offering therapy and psychiatry in person and by telehealth. It bills insurance; its billing page (June 2025) lists self-pay initial appointments of about $188 to $573 and therapy sessions around $188 in Minnesota, with a sliding-scale discount based on income and family size, and $65 to $135 no-show or late-cancel fees. No published study of its services was found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; about $188/session self-pay therapy in Minnesota
pricing.notes: Billing page (June 2025): self-pay initial appointments about $188–$573 depending on service and state; sliding-scale discount by income and family size (call 651-379-1704); no-show and late-cancel fees $65–$135 with 24 hours' notice required.

privacy.notes: Sagent Behavioral Health website policy (read 2026-10-27) says it and its providers use your data to deliver relevant ads on other services, third-party ad networks track you via cookies across devices, and data may be shared with business partners for their marketing; deletion on request.
